title: Das Kloster-Tagebuch des Einsiedler Paters Joseph Dietrich, 1670-1704 – Kommentierte Online-Edition
author: Joseph Dietrich
institution: Abteilung für Wirtschafts-, Sozial- und Umweltgeschichte, Historisches Institut, Universität Bern
notes: The diary has 18 volumes and about 12,000 pages; a diplomatic transcription with footnotes, Latin translations, weather observations and registers is published volume by volume. Four volumes are online so far: Band 6 (1687-1688), Band 13 (1688-1690), Band 15 (1693-1694) and Band 17 (1697-1698); all are within the period. The others are transcribed but not yet published. No word count: each scan has its own page mixing transcription, margin notes and translations, so a clean count was not made. Band 17 and a new full-text search were added on 9 October 2026.
